design_authority: SOLIDWORKS native C2R1 candidate + controlled work packages
material_state: P003/P007 316L controlled; P006 production material OPEN; FKM 75A is the preferred bounded-BOF seal candidate with FFKM fallback; exact seal and fastener supplier products remain qualification items.
assumptions: local J2 metal temperature envelope not yet measured/frozen
50 service cycles is provisional qualification target
exact FKM/FFKM supplier compound must be approved against the bounded actual media/temperature envelope
change_impact: C2R1 nominal CAD geometry remains frozen; v8 changes release specifications/tolerances/service feature/process controls, not the proven OD33 package.

gates.question: Does J2 remain removable and sealed?
gates.basis: C2R1 retains a removable static-sealed P003↔P007 interface.

gates.question: Are locating, clamping and sealing functions separated?
gates.basis: Pilot locates radially, metal faces axially, one hole clocks, 3 screws clamp, O-ring seals.

gates.question: Is the datum architecture deterministic without overconstraint?
gates.basis: Ø14.10 H7/g6 and mating face are verified; one clamp-hole axis is used only for clocking.

gates.question: Are governing load cases bounded?
gates.basis: Pressure reaction is only 3.1225 N; seal compression and service preload govern the clamp design.

gates.question: Do M2.5 threads/flange pass the current bounded preload envelope?
gates.basis: For 200–300 N/screw candidate preload, thread strip SF is ≥3.10 at 300 N/screw; conservative local strip-bending screen is ≈135.6 MPa at 300 N/screw vs 170 MPa 316L screening yield.
open_actions: T07 structural refresh / local contact confirmation

gates.question: Does P007 retain buckling margin after final J2 freeze?
gates.basis: Historical λ1=1883.6 is strong but must be refreshed on final geometry.

gates.question: Can service torque be reacted without damaging P006/J2?
gates.basis: Two-pin P006 face-drive candidate has low nominal pin stresses at 0.5 N·m structural tool capacity; actual P006 seating torque remains process-controlled.
gates.verification_method: analytic tool feature screen + service trial

gates.question: Is repeated service life demonstrated?
gates.basis: A provisional 50-cycle qualification is defined; test evidence does not yet exist.

gates.question: Is thermally induced preload bounded?
gates.basis: A4 stainless and 316L have closely matched expansion; a conservative Δα study still gives only tens of newtons per screw over 100 K, but seal force/compression set is temperature dependent.
gates.verification_method: thermal preload analysis + hot torque/retention check

gates.question: Is loosening under vibration explicitly disposed?
gates.basis: No released locking method yet.

gates.question: Is gland geometry robust and is material qualified?
gates.basis: 16×1.5 gland geometry is bounded, but the exact J2-local temperature and released process-media envelope are not yet fully bounded. FKM 75A is the preferred BOF production candidate; FFKM is a controlled fallback. Exact compound, compression force and leak acceptance remain release evidence.
gates.verification_method: media/temperature qualification + tolerance stack + supplier compound evidence + compression-force/leak test

gates.question: Does the compact flange alter controlled sample-flow geometry?
gates.basis: External J2 flange package does not change the controlled sample-flow/rod wetted geometry.

gates.question: Is final magnetic force margin verified on released P015/B001?
gates.basis: Final FEMM remains after P015/B001 freeze.

gates.question: Are structural and sealing materials compatible with the bounded environment?
gates.basis: P003/P007 material is controlled as 316L. P006 production material is not yet confirmed by a controlled source. The J2 elastomer family strategy is defined, but exact compound and local media/temperature qualification remain open.

gates.question: Do worst-case tolerances retain assembly/clearance?
gates.basis: C2R1 functional chains are treated as worst-case assembly/interface stacks; pilot/head and fastener-pattern stacks currently pass at study tolerances.
gates.verification_method: worst-case stackup across P003↔P006 and P003↔P007 mating interfaces; include fit, datum and position variation
open_actions: confirm drawing GD&T in native output

gates.question: Can normal turning/drilling/tapping/inspection make it?
gates.basis: Round OD33, reamed/turned locating features and 3-hole pattern are simple. Small M2.5 tapping in 316L and P006 Ø1.5 blind service holes need shop capability confirmation.

gates.question: Does native assembly constrain the joint as designed?
gates.basis: Native verify PASS with 0 active mate errors and no new hard interference.

gates.question: Can the joint be opened and P006 actuated?
gates.basis: No weld; dedicated two-pin hollow face-drive architecture is selected.

gates.question: Can every release characteristic be inspected/tested?
gates.basis: Drawing Intent now links each release characteristic to a defined inspection method; exact leak-test acceptance and some final production tolerances remain open.

gates.question: Are loosening, galling, seal and service FMs closed?
gates.basis: Failure modes are identified but qualification evidence remains open.

gates.question: Does J2 maintain containment for hazardous MARV service?
gates.basis: MARV documentation treats sampled gas as potentially toxic/explosive and containment as safety-relevant; leak/material evidence is therefore a release gate.

gates.question: Are exact screw/seal purchasable specs released?
gates.basis: Size/classes are selected; exact M2.5 finish/lubrication and FFKM supplier compound are open.
open_actions: freeze exact B011 and screw source

gates.question: Is the compact solution economically proportionate?
gates.basis: OD33 round turned flange and 3 screws minimize machining. FFKM is expensive but one small safety-critical seal has low system-level cost; FKM remains an application-approved cost-down option only after media compatibility proof.

gates.question: Can manufacturing/inspection trace each characteristic to requirement and evidence?
gates.basis: MEDTAS v8 separates nominal CAD geometry, released allowable variation, decision rationale, verification evidence and derived state; Drawing Intent implements design-intent-to-inspection traceability.
